faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Every project is quoted for your business after a free consultation, in a written plan you see before any work starts. See /pricing for the packages.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: The timeline is in your written plan, agreed with you before any work starts.

faqs.question: What are your payment terms?
faqs.answer: Payment terms are agreed in the written plan, after a free consultation.

faqs.question: Do you offer support after launch?
faqs.answer: For apps, yes: after launch we keep it running and help with changes. Ask about support in your free consultation, at /contact.

faqs.question: Do I own my social media accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. You always own your accounts. We post for you, and the accounts stay in your business's name.

faqs.question: Who pays for the ads?
faqs.answer: Your ad spend is separate from our management fee.

faqs.question: Where is your team located?
faqs._source: STS-058: answered from src/config/business.ts (address, else serviceAreaText) by locationReply() in src/services/chatbot-facts.ts.

faqs.question: Do you have experience in my industry?
faqs.answer: We have built platforms in Healthcare (MIMAP clinic), E-commerce (iSaraya marketplace), Education (ASTA academy), Automotive (BMV Inspection) and Transportation (Saraya Auto Rental). See /our-work.

booking._source: STS-058: the booking answer is built by bookingReply() in src/services/chatbot-facts.ts from bookingHref()/hasVerifiedBooking() in src/config/business.ts. Unverified booking = the /contact form.
